cue.simpleMeaning: A small signal that tells you to start a habit.
cue.contextMeaning: A signal after breakfast that prompts you to eat fruit.
cue.translationJa: 習慣を始める小さな合図。
cue.translationEs: Una señal pequeña que te dice que empieces un hábito.
cue.example: After breakfast is a clear cue for eating a piece of fruit.

repetition.simpleMeaning: Doing the same action many times.
repetition.contextMeaning: Doing the action every day after the signal.
repetition.translationJa: 同じことを何度もすること。
repetition.translationEs: Hacer la misma acción muchas veces.
repetition.example: Repetition made the action feel automatic after about 66 days.

automatic.contextMeaning: The action was done without thinking after many days.
automatic.example: On average, the action felt automatic after about 66 days.

tiny action.simpleMeaning: A very small step easy to do often.
tiny action.contextMeaning: Reading one page after coffee as a small step.
tiny action.translationJa: 簡単にできるとても小さな行動。
tiny action.translationEs: Un paso muy pequeño fácil de hacer a menudo.
tiny action.example: Maria's tiny action was reading one page after coffee.

habit.simpleMeaning: Something you do often without thinking.
habit.contextMeaning: A habit starts when a signal and small step come together.
habit.translationJa: よく無意識に行うこと。
habit.translationEs: Algo que haces a menudo sin pensar.
habit.example: A habit grows when a clear cue meets one tiny action.

breakfast.simpleMeaning: The first meal of the day eaten in the morning.
breakfast.contextMeaning: The meal eaten in the morning before other activities.
breakfast.translationJa: 朝食（あさごはん）、朝の最初の食事。
breakfast.translationEs: Desayuno, la primera comida del día por la mañana.
breakfast.example: Each person chose a clear cue, like "after breakfast," and then did one small action, like eating a piece of fruit.

hour.contextMeaning: A time of 60 minutes to study or read.
hour.translationEs: Una hora, un periodo de 60 minutos.
hour.example: Tom tells himself he will read for one hour every day.

maria.contextMeaning: Name of a woman in the sentence.
maria.example: Maria puts one book next to her coffee cup every night.

tom.contextMeaning: Name of a man in the sentence.
tom.example: Tom tells himself he will read for one hour every day.

average.simpleMeaning: The usual result found from a group of numbers or examples.
average.contextMeaning: Here, on average means 66 days was the usual result for the group.
average.translationEs: El resultado habitual de un grupo de números o ejemplos.
average.example: On average, people needed about 66 days before the action felt truly automatic.

chart.simpleMeaning: A picture that shows information with lines, bars, or numbers.
chart.contextMeaning: Here, the chart showed how the habit became easier over time.
chart.translationJa: 情報を線・棒・数字で示す図表。
chart.translationEs: Un gráfico que muestra información con líneas, barras o números.
chart.example: At first, the line on their chart went up quickly.
